mentions.name: ShredLog
mentions.description: A block training app for skateboarding that applies modern block training, progression gates, and tracking methods so skaters learn fundamentals and practice in a logical, structured way. Currently a small MVP.
mentions.problem: The vast majority of skaters don't land anything consistently and just huck their skateboard around; unlike athletes in other sports who follow progressions, most skaters never learn fundamentals or practice logically.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just (vibe) coded up a little block training app for skateboarding. I noticed that the vast majority of skaters don't land anything consistently and just huck their skateboard around.
